info.title: Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt
info.synopsis: La storia è incentrata su due ragazze un po' particolari, come i loro nomi: Panty, bionda e con il tipico abbigliamento da idol, e Stocking, una gothic lolita dai capelli corvini. Queste stravaganti ragazze sono, in realtà , due angeli mandati dal Cielo per combattere i "Ghosts" sulla Terra'

episodes.title: The Turmoil of the Beehive

tvdb.title: The Turmoil of the Beehive
tvdb.synopsis: While investigating a series of disappearances at Daten City High School, Panty and Stocking encounter Queen Barby, the cheerleading team captain whose reign as the most popular student is threatened by the Anarchy sisters. With the help of the teenage occult geek Brief, Panty and Stocking expose Barby as the Ghost behind the school's disappearances.

episodes.title: Sex and the Daten City

tvdb.title: Sex and the Daten City
tvdb.synopsis: At the preview of her and Stocking's first feature film, Panty screens a pornographic film she once starred in, which leaks to the public. With her celebrity lifestyle at risk, Panty travels the world with Stocking and destroys every copy of the porn in existence save for one, which the sisters decide to keep for themselves. But when Panty reveals she edited out all of Stocking's scenes in their film, Stocking gets revenge by uploading the last porn copy online.

episodes.title: The Diet Syndrome

tvdb.title: The Diet Syndrome
tvdb.synopsis: Stocking finds herself gaining weight and goes on an intense diet, but she only keeps getting fatter until she balloons into a giant. When the cause is revealed to be from an obese Ghost who refuses to diet, Stocking sets out for revenge. Upon defeating the Ghost, Stocking returns to her original figure.
